packages.title: Meetings card and FAQ: payoff first, the app's Create task review, its note's order
brief: One package for the whole meetings card and the FAQ's meeting sentence, because all six findings touch the same strings and the same test copy. It corrects this run's own uncommitted WD36 change in place (see the conventions). The card's facts stay exactly WD36's; what changes is one false-in-its-words sentence, the order (payoff first), the heading, the example note's order and labels, and the Spanish and Catalan FAQ wording.

WEB-2103 (S1), the heading. `features.meetings.title` (`src/content/site/en.ts:80`, `es.ts:80`, `ca.ts:86`) starts with ‘Notes’ right after the details card's ‘Notes, checklists and files’, so the two headings read alike. Replace it with the app's own words for the feature (`billingReasonMeetingNotes`, `../TaskFlow/App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:4461`, `app_es.arb:1505`, `app_ca.arb:1209`, without ‘With Pro,’ and the colon): EN `Your meetings become notes` / ES `Tus reuniones se convierten en notas` / CA `Les teves reunions es converteixen en notes`.

WEB-2101 (S2) and WEB-2102 (S1), the body. `features.meetings.body` (`en.ts:81`, `es.ts:81`, `ca.ts:87`) says ‘Turn the to-dos into a task with a checklist in one tap’ (ES «…con un toque», CA «…amb un toc»). That isn't true in those words: Create task (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:598-604`) calls `createTaskFromNote` (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/widgets/note_task.dart:139-190`), which opens the capture review with the to-dos ticked; the person checks them and saves with Add task (`captureAddTask`). And the body leads with a how-to, so on a phone the payoff arrives on line 3–4. Replace the whole body with this, which keeps Pro first, states the notes first, uses the app's button names and describes the review as the voice card does (‘Check them, then add them all with one tap’): EN `With TaskFlow Pro, record a meeting and get its notes: a summary, the to-dos, the decisions and the open questions. Tap Record a meeting in Notes, lock your phone if you like, and press Stop. Create task turns the to-dos into a task with a checklist: check it, then add it. Up to 20 hours of meetings a month.` / ES `Con TaskFlow Pro, graba una reunión y recibe sus notas: un resumen, las cosas por hacer, las decisiones y las preguntas abiertas. Toca Grabar una reunión en Notas, bloquea el móvil si quieres y pulsa Parar. Crear tarea convierte las cosas por hacer en una tarea con su lista de pasos: revísala y añádela. Hasta 20 horas de reuniones al mes.` / CA `Amb TaskFlow Pro, enregistra una reunió i rep-ne les notes: un resum, les coses per fer, les decisions i les preguntes obertes. Toca Enregistra una reunió a Notes, bloqueja el mòbil si vols i prem Atura. El botó Crea una tasca converteix les coses per fer en una tasca amb la seva llista de passos: revisa-la i afegeix-la. Fins a 20 hores de reunions al mes.`. The Catalan third sentence opens «El botó Crea una tasca…» rather than the review's bare «Crea una tasca converteix…», because an imperative button name as the subject reads as a command in Catalan; the organizer's change, for a native read.

WEB-2002 (S2) and WEB-2105 (S1), the FAQ. WD36 built WEB-2002's clause as its own sentence in the ‘Is TaskFlow free?’ answer's Pro paragraph (`en.ts:109`, `es.ts:109`, `ca.ts:115`). The English stays exactly ‘It makes notes from the meetings you record too, up to 20 hours a month.’ Spanish «hace notas» and Catalan «fa notes» are calques: replace those sentences only, with ES `También toma notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 20 horas al mes.` / CA `També pren notes de les reunions que enregistres, fins a 20 hores al mes.`. Nothing else in that paragraph changes.

WEB-2104 (S1), the example note (`src/components/HomePage.tsx:132-158`, `src/content/site/{en,es,ca}.ts` `features.meetings.note`, `src/content/site/types.ts` its type, `src/styles/global.css:757-831`). Today its order is title, header, summary, two unlabelled checkboxes, Decisions, Create task with a check icon. The app's note page puts the steps first, labelled (`task_detail_screen.dart:496-499`, UX-2708), then the note's words opening with its header line; its Create task carries an add-task icon, not a check. Make the drawing follow the app, with one new label and nothing else new:

(1) Add a string `checklist` to the note's type in `types.ts` and to each language: EN `Checklist · 0/2` / ES `Pasos · 0/2` / CA `Passos · 0/2` (the app's `checklistCount` with nothing done of the two to-dos). (2) Change `note.header` to EN `Meeting on Tuesday · 42 min` / ES `Reunión del martes · 42 min` / CA `Reunió del dimarts · 42 min` (the app's `meetingNoteHeader`, with the weekday alone). The title, summary, steps, ‘Decisions’, the decision and the button text stay as they are. (3) In `HomePage.tsx`, render in this order inside `.meeting-illustration`: the title (`.meeting-note-title`); the checklist label (a `<strong>` with `.meeting-note-label` and a class of its own for its spacing, e.g. `.meeting-checklist-label`); the `<ul>` of the two to-dos; the header line (`<small>`); the summary (`.meeting-line`); ‘Decisions’ (`.meeting-note-label`); the decision; the Create task pill. Keep `aria-hidden="true"` on the drawing, no link or button inside it, exactly two `li`. (4) Drop the pill's `<Icon name="check" …/>` (subtract: there is no add-task icon in `src/components/Icon.tsx`, and the text alone is the app's label); remove the pill's `gap` if it no longer has a child to space. Don't touch `Icon.tsx`. (5) In `global.css`, move the thin separator so it divides the checklist from the note's words, as the app's page does: the `ul` loses its `border-top` and top padding and sits close under the checklist label (about 8 px); the header line `small` gets the `border-top: 1px solid var(--line)`, about 12 px padding above its text and about 12 px margin above the line. The checklist label sits about 12 px under the title. Add `text-wrap: pretty;` to `.meeting-line`.

Tests the implementer updates: `tests/support/ux-web-copy.ts:85-91` (the meetings entry's title and body, all three languages, exactly as above) and `PRO_MEETINGS` in `tests/ux-web-features.spec.ts:1054-1058` (ES and CA as above; EN unchanged). The WD36 test's regexes (`tests/ux-web-features.spec.ts:1922-1926`) must still pass unchanged. The 1440 px grid test (`:304-331`) reads its heading list from `ux-web-copy.ts`, so it follows.

Don't touch: the other feature cards, the voice card's and the voice FAQ's ‘one tap’ (they are true), the closing card and the line under the demo (WD2, WD14; WD37 is open), `Icon.tsx`, the card's grid placement and colours, the privacy page, and anything in `src/content/legal/`.
acceptance: On /, /es/ and /ca/ (desktop 1440 × 1000 and mobile 390 × 664, light), `#features .feature-meetings h3` reads exactly EN ‘Your meetings become notes’ / ES «Tus reuniones se convierten en notas» / CA «Les teves reunions es converteixen en notes», and its `.feature-card-copy p` reads exactly the brief's body in that language.

In each language, the meetings card's paragraph contains no ‘one tap’ / «un toque» / «un toc», contains ‘Create task’ / «Crear tarea» / «Crea una tasca», and its first sentence contains ‘notes’ / «notas» / «notes» before the first ‘Record a meeting’ / «Grabar una reunión» / «Enregistra una reunió», matched case-sensitively as the app's button name (the first sentence's lowercase ‘record a meeting’ / «graba una reunión» / «enregistra una reunió» is the verb, not the button). In the whole home page's text, ‘one tap’ / «un toque» / «un toc» appears exactly twice: in the voice card and in the ‘How do I add tasks by voice?’ answer.

The existing WD36 test (‘the meetings card names Pro, the app's Record a meeting and Stop, and 20 hours a month…’) passes unchanged, and so do the WD36 stacking test and the 1440 px grid test (meetings full width below the calendar, no card more than a quarter empty) in light and dark.
At 320 px wide (mobile project, light), the meetings h3 is at most two lines in ES and CA; no page scrolls sideways at 320 or 390 px in any language.

On /es/ and /ca/, the open ‘¿TaskFlow es gratis?’ / ‘TaskFlow és gratuït?’ answer's second paragraph contains exactly «También toma notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 20 horas al mes.» / «També pren notes de les reunions que enregistres, fins a 20 hores al mes.», and the page contains neither «hace notas» nor «fa notes». On /, it still contains exactly ‘It makes notes from the meetings you record too, up to 20 hours a month.’

In each language, `.meeting-illustration`'s visible text runs in this order: the note title; ‘Checklist · 0/2’ / «Pasos · 0/2» / «Passos · 0/2»; the two to-dos; ‘Meeting on Tuesday · 42 min’ / «Reunión del martes · 42 min» / «Reunió del dimarts · 42 min»; the summary; ‘Decisions’ / «Decisiones» / «Decisions»; the decision; ‘Create task’ / «Crear tarea» / «Crea una tasca» last. The drawing keeps `aria-hidden="true"`, exactly two `li` and no `a` or `button`, and `.meeting-button` contains no `svg`.

`.meeting-line` computes `text-wrap-style: pretty` (or `text-wrap: pretty`). At 320 px (mobile project, light), the summary's last rendered line holds at least two words in EN, ES and CA (the review saw CA end on «prepara.»).

The checklist label's text contrast is at least 4.5:1 on the note's background in light and dark, and axe reports no violations on /, /es/ and /ca/ at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 664, in light and dark. Expected render: `home.en.desktop.light.full.png` and `home.es.mobile.light.full.png` show the label and the two to-dos at the note's top, a thin line, then the header line, summary, Decisions and the Create task pill without an icon.

A native Catalan read of the new heading, body and FAQ sentence («rep-ne les notes», «El botó Crea una tasca converteix…: revisa-la i afegeix-la», «pren notes de les reunions»).

On a real phone, once meeting notes are checked there: Create task opens the review with the to-dos ticked, and Add task saves one task with them as its checklist, as the card's ‘check it, then add it’ says. The card rests on the code and the app's preview renders, not a device.
Safari on a real iPhone: the meetings card and its note at 390 and 320 px (no WebKit in this session; `text-wrap: pretty` is newer in Safari).

decisions.question: Should the closing card and the line under the demo name meeting notes among what Pro gives? (WEB-2106, review F's Q-F1.) Both say ‘TaskFlow Pro, a monthly subscription: unlimited dictation and file space.’ (`src/content/site/en.ts:154`, ES 154, CA 160), short by WD2 and WD14. Options: (a) keep as is; (b) add EN ‘and notes from your meetings’ / ES «y notas de tus reuniones» / CA «i notes de les teves reunions».
decisions.recommendation: (a), keep as is. The meetings card and the FAQ now carry the feature, and those lines' job is the free limit; revisit (b) only if the five-person test shows people miss it. Nothing waits on it: WP273 doesn't touch those lines.
